direct_contractual_counterparty: Issuer/counterparty varies by instrument; exact portfolio split not frozen
direct_flow_identity: Coupon/devengement can be issuer→bank; price appreciation is not a contemporaneous issuer payment
economic_funder_or_incidence: LEBAC/NOBAC are BCRA liabilities; Treasury securities are Treasury liabilities; secondary-market gains are valuation effects
fiscal_or_BCRA_link: BCRA link supported for LEBAC/NOBAC mechanism; Treasury share N/D
caveat: The +1.4pp securities gap cannot be split into BCRA/Treasury/market shares with current frozen evidence.

direct_flow_identity: Indexation is contractual, but the aggregate result is the net of heterogeneous indexed positions
economic_funder_or_incidence: Could arise from CER public bonds, indexed loans, deposits or other indexed contracts
fiscal_or_BCRA_link: Fiscal link only for identified Treasury CER instruments
caveat: Aggregate CER result does not identify which indexed contracts generated the gap.

direct_contractual_counterparty: Underlying FX debtors/depositors/market positions not split
direct_flow_identity: Revaluation of a net FX position is not itself a cash transfer from a household
economic_funder_or_incidence: Economic incidence sits on holders of the underlying assets/liabilities and the bank own position; no one-to-one payer
caveat: January overshoot was FX, but annual abnormal FX gap is slightly negative.

direct_contractual_counterparty: Underlying borrowers; sector mix not frozen
direct_flow_identity: Provision/credit-loss charge is a bank accounting cost tied to borrower risk, not a payment received from the delinquent borrower
economic_funder_or_incidence: Lower loss charge benefits bank results by reducing a cost; it does not establish a household→bank flow
caveat: Household share of the credit portfolio is not isolated in this abnormal-gap row.

direct_flow_identity: Bank→tax authority tax payment/accrual
economic_funder_or_incidence: Fiscal authority receives tax; this is an offset to bank profit
fiscal_or_BCRA_link: Direct fiscal counterparty for national income tax
caveat: Negative component; not part of bank benefit.

direct_contractual_counterparty: Issuer and market vary by security
direct_flow_identity: Coupon/devengement may be issuer→bank; mark-to-market has no contemporaneous issuer payment
economic_funder_or_incidence: 2018 portfolio included BCRA instruments and Treasury securities; exact abnormal share by issuer N/D
fiscal_or_BCRA_link: BCRA and Treasury links both plausible/supported institutionally, magnitude N/D
caveat: No exact H1 subcomponent gap frozen.

direct_flow_identity: Contractual indexation on assets
economic_funder_or_incidence: Depends on composition of CER/UVA assets; household share not isolated
caveat: Gross CER income is not net CER result and counterparty mix is unresolved.

direct_flow_identity: For identified household loans/cards: household→bank interest is a direct contractual flow
economic_funder_or_incidence: Aggregate interest income mixes sectors, so the household contribution to the abnormal gap is N/D
fiscal_or_BCRA_link: Possible Treasury link for public-sector borrowers/instruments
caveat: This is the first component family where a direct household contract can exist, but V52 cannot quantify its share.

direct_contractual_counterparty: Underlying net FX position; gross counterparties heterogeneous
direct_flow_identity: Peso depreciation × net long FX exposure → accounting FX/ORI gain; no required household cash payment
economic_funder_or_incidence: Gain accrues from revaluation of own net position; underlying positions can involve many sectors
fiscal_or_BCRA_link: No direct fiscal identity; some underlying FX assets may be Treasury Letes
caveat: Official attribution identifies the FX mechanism, not the economic payer.

direct_flow_identity: Bank→depositor/funder interest payment/accrual
economic_funder_or_incidence: Depositors receive this flow; households can be beneficiaries rather than funders of bank profit
caveat: Depositor sector split is not frozen.

direct_flow_identity: BCRA↔bank repo/pase contractual premium
economic_funder_or_incidence: Direct BCRA monetary-policy instrument flow; H1 direction was an offset, not a positive abnormal source
caveat: Exact H1 gap N/D.

direct_contractual_counterparty: Borrowers underlying the impaired portfolio; sector mix
direct_flow_identity: Expected/realized credit loss is borne by bank balance; delinquency is not itself a payment to the bank
economic_funder_or_incidence: Higher household/corporate distress can reduce bank result through provisions
caveat: Falsifies the idea that mora mechanically generated the abnormal positive bank result.

direct_flow_identity: Identified household-loan interest would be household→bank; aggregate row mixes sectors
economic_funder_or_incidence: Household share of +2.1pp cannot be isolated from current aggregate table
caveat: At most +2.1pp is the accounting ceiling for all borrower-interest channels combined; it is not a household estimate.

direct_flow_identity: Bank→depositor/funder interest
economic_funder_or_incidence: Negative bank component; private deposits are a main funding source
caveat: Household/corporate split N/D.

direct_flow_identity: Net indexation result combines income and expense sides
economic_funder_or_incidence: A positive exposure gap does not imply the quarterly abnormal contribution is positive; Q4 gap is -0.2pp
fiscal_or_BCRA_link: Fiscal link only for identified Treasury CER assets
caveat: Aggregate CER/CVS cannot be assigned to households.

direct_contractual_counterparty: Underlying net FX position; gross counterparties heterogeneous
direct_flow_identity: Exchange-rate move × net FX exposure → accounting valuation result
economic_funder_or_incidence: No one-to-one payer; underlying assets/liabilities may involve depositors, firms, public sector or market positions
fiscal_or_BCRA_link: No direct fiscal identity at aggregate component level
caveat: Q4 includes Oct-Nov pre-10Dec, so +11.3pp is not a December-only causal amount.

direct_flow_identity: BCRA incurs repo/pase premium expense; bank records corresponding premium income
economic_funder_or_incidence: Immediate incidence is on BCRA balance/result/liabilities. Broader monetary/fiscal incidence is conditional, not a direct taxpayer payment
fiscal_or_BCRA_link: BCRA direct; quasi-fiscal/monetary bridge supported, taxpayer identity rejected
caveat: Q4 gap includes pre-19Dec weeks; do not attribute all +7.7pp to the policy substitution.

direct_contractual_counterparty: Issuer and/or market depending instrument and accounting treatment
direct_flow_identity: Coupon/devengement: issuer→bank; secondary-market price gain/ORI: valuation without contemporaneous issuer payment
economic_funder_or_incidence: BCRA links elevated levels to public-sector financing and positive market prices; exact issuer/valuation decomposition N/D
fiscal_or_BCRA_link: Treasury/BCRA/public-sector link large institutionally but exact +7.3pp split N/D
caveat: Cannot label the whole +7.3pp as Treasury payment or subsidy.

direct_flow_identity: Inflation accounting remeasurement of net monetary position; not a bilateral payment
economic_funder_or_incidence: Bank bears purchasing-power loss/gain from net monetary exposure
caveat: Strong falsifier of any single-sign claim from inflation to bank profit.

direct_flow_identity: N/D
economic_funder_or_incidence: N/D
caveat: Too small and insufficiently decomposed to assign incidence.

direct_flow_identity: Provision/credit-loss expense is borne by bank; nonpayment is not a transfer to bank
economic_funder_or_incidence: Household distress can hurt bank results through this channel
caveat: Current Q4 aggregate does not isolate household credit losses.

direct_flow_identity: Bank→tax authority tax accrual/payment
economic_funder_or_incidence: Fiscal authority receives tax; offset to bank profitability
caveat: Not a positive bank-benefit channel.
